After determination of the amount of amino acid(s) (protein) 
to be supplied by the diet, the balance of the calculated protein
needs is provided by a speciﬁ cally designed metabolic for-
mula or food. Th e metabolic formula is usually a powder that
contains all of the amino acids except for the one(s) that are 
not able to be metabolized appropriately. Th e powder formula
can contain a carbohydrate source, a fat source that includes 
essential fatty acids, and vitamins and minerals.
